declarations.name: OcelleBrandMark

members.name: ground
members.description:
The ground the mark sits on: `chrome` for the dark chrome grounds (`color-chrome`, `color-chrome-hover`); absent or
any other value for the main grounds. Reflected.

members.name: tone
members.description:
`mono` paints ring and spot in `currentColor`, the colour of the surrounding text, and wins over `ground`; absent
or any other value paints the variant of `ground`. Reflected.

members.name: label
members.description:
The accessible name of the mark, trimmed; empty or whitespace-only counts as none, and without one the mark is
hidden from the accessibility tree. Not reflected.

declarations.name: OcelleButton

members.name: variant
members.description:
The look: `primary` (filled), `secondary` (bordered on a surface) or `quiet` (bordered, no fill); absent or any
other value renders `secondary`. Reflected.

members.name: size
members.description:
`default` (at least `--ocelle-target-min` in both dimensions) or `compact` (the compact text scale, at least 24 px
in both dimensions); absent or any other value renders `default`. Reflected.

members.name: flush
members.description:
No inline padding, no border and no fill: a text-like control whose content starts at its inline start, with only
its hover surface and focus ring. Reflected.

members.name: ground
members.description:
The ground the button sits on: `accent-low`, `inset`, `hover-bg` or `state` (a state ground) give a bordered
variant an `--ocelle-color-accent-strong` border; `chrome` gives the chrome look for the chrome grounds; absent or
any other value means the other main grounds. Reflected.

members.name: label
members.description:
The accessible name of the button, trimmed; empty or whitespace-only counts as none, and the name is then the
content. Not reflected.

members.name: disabled
members.description:
Disabled: out of the tab order, reported disabled and not activated (no `click`, no `ocelle-button-activate`).
Reflected.

members.name: href
members.description:
The link's URL: a non-empty `href` that parses as a URL and is not a `javascript:` URL puts the button in link mode
(an inner `<a>` with the `href` as written); any other value is button mode. Reflected.

members.name: target
members.description:
The inner link's `target`, in link mode while available; with `_blank` and no `rel` the link gets `rel="noopener"`.
Reflected.

members.name: rel
members.description: The inner link's `rel`, in link mode while available. Reflected.

members.name: download
members.description: The inner link's `download`, in link mode while available. Reflected.

members.name: click
members.description:
Clicks the inner control, so the click passes through it and is guarded like any other: a disabled button ignores
it.

events.name: ocelle-button-activate
events.description: Dispatched from the element on each activation that delivers a `click` (a pointer click, Enter, Space in button mode, `click()`), before the `click` reaches any bubble-phase listener on the element or its ancestors; bubbles, composed and cancelable, `detail` `{}`. Calling `preventDefault()` on it cancels the click's default action (in link mode the navigation; in button mode the `click` is still delivered). Not dispatched for a link-mode click with Ctrl, Meta, Shift or Alt held, nor for a middle click. A disabled button dispatches neither.

declarations.description:
A native button in the Ocelle look, or a link that looks like one: three variants, two sizes, a flush look, the
ground it sits on, a label, a disabled state, an icon slot, link mode with `href`, and host ARIA moved onto the inner
control.

cssStates.name: current
cssStates.description: While the moved `aria-current` is set to any value other than `"false"`.

cssParts.name: control
cssParts.description: The inner `<button>`, or the inner `<a>` in link mode.

attributes.name: aria-expanded
attributes.description: Moved onto the inner control (the host keeps no copy): `"true"` reports expanded, `"false"` collapsed, an empty value clears it; `removeAttribute` after the move changes nothing.

attributes.name: aria-controls
attributes.description: Moved onto the inner control: the ids, space-separated, of the elements it controls, resolved in the host's own tree when set and when the element is connected; an empty value clears it.

attributes.name: aria-current
attributes.description: Moved onto the inner control with any value; `"false"` or an empty value clears it. It draws no mark.

attributes.name: aria-haspopup
attributes.description: Moved onto the inner control: the kind of popup it opens; an empty value clears it.

attributes.name: aria-pressed
attributes.description: Moved onto the inner control in button mode only: `"true"` reports pressed, `"false"` not pressed, an empty value clears it.

attributes.name: aria-label
attributes.description: Moved onto the inner control: its accessible name, over `label` and the content; an empty or whitespace-only value clears it.

attributes.name: aria-labelledby
attributes.description: Moved onto the inner control: the ids, space-separated, of the elements that name it, resolved in the host's own tree, over `aria-label`; an empty value clears it.

attributes.name: aria-describedby
attributes.description: Moved onto the inner control: the ids, space-separated, of the elements that describe it, resolved in the host's own tree; an empty value clears it.

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: Moved onto the inner control: its native tooltip and description, or its name when nothing else names it; an empty value clears it.

attributes.name: data-ocelle-moved-aria-expanded
attributes.description: Element-owned mirror of the moved `aria-expanded`, so copies of the live DOM keep it; hosts do not write or remove it, and the element restores it when it is removed or changed.

attributes.name: data-ocelle-moved-aria-controls
attributes.description: Element-owned mirror of the moved `aria-controls`; hosts do not write or remove it.

attributes.name: data-ocelle-moved-aria-current
attributes.description: Element-owned mirror of the moved `aria-current`; hosts do not write or remove it.

attributes.name: data-ocelle-moved-aria-haspopup
attributes.description: Element-owned mirror of the moved `aria-haspopup`; hosts do not write or remove it.

attributes.name: data-ocelle-moved-aria-pressed
attributes.description: Element-owned mirror of the moved `aria-pressed`; hosts do not write or remove it.

attributes.name: data-ocelle-moved-aria-label
attributes.description: Element-owned mirror of the moved `aria-label`; hosts do not write or remove it.

attributes.name: data-ocelle-moved-aria-labelledby
attributes.description: Element-owned mirror of the moved `aria-labelledby`; hosts do not write or remove it.

attributes.name: data-ocelle-moved-aria-describedby
attributes.description: Element-owned mirror of the moved `aria-describedby`; hosts do not write or remove it.

attributes.name: data-ocelle-moved-title
attributes.description: Element-owned mirror of the moved `title`; hosts do not write or remove it.
